title: ComplianceAlertValuesMeasuredPayload
description: Payload of the ComplianceAlertValuesMeasured event (INV-REQ-1069, INV-Q-12767 A; class: domain). Sent at most once per entity, period and measuredOn, and only when documentsWithoutSubmission is at least 1. No tenant or entity label is a metric label: entity and period are payload fields. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

periodRef.description: The prescribed accounting period reference, e.g. 2026Q1.

measuredOn.description: The day the values were measured.

documentsWithoutSubmission.description: In-scope documents with no submission; the event is sent only when this is at least 1.

daysToNearestDeadline.description: Days to the nearest deadline; absent when none.
